# mode golden args... (run from the package folder)
# hand cases: single statements, programs, files with errors, and the limits
exact tests/golden-acases.txt acases
# seeded property runs against the encoder and decoder of emu-rv64, no second assembler
exact tests/golden-aprops-1.txt aprops 1 20000
exact tests/golden-aprops-7.txt aprops 7 50000
# every planted defect must be refused by the cases and by the properties
exact tests/golden-acontrols.txt acontrols
# the timer program of emu-rv64: the words, the bytes, and three comparisons
exact tests/golden-asm-timer.txt asm tests/timer.s
exact tests/golden-bytes-timer.txt bytes tests/timer.s
exact tests/golden-match-timer.txt match tests/timer.s timer
exact tests/golden-same-timer.txt same tests/timer.s tests/emu-timer.img
exact tests/golden-dis-timer.txt dis tests/golden-asm-timer.txt
# the trap-handler, serial and sum programs of emu-rv64
exact tests/golden-asm-trap.txt asm tests/trap.s
exact tests/golden-match-trap.txt match tests/trap.s trap
exact tests/golden-asm-serial.txt asm tests/serial.s
exact tests/golden-asm-sum.txt asm tests/sum.s
# the hand cases of emu-rv64 as text, compared with the words in its golden files
exact tests/golden-asm-hand-cases.txt asm tests/hand-cases.s
exact tests/golden-hand-cases.txt hand tests/hand-cases.s tests/emu-golden-cases.txt
exact tests/golden-asm-hand-mcases.txt asm tests/hand-mcases.s
exact tests/golden-hand-mcases.txt hand tests/hand-mcases.s tests/emu-golden-mcases.txt
exact tests/golden-asm-hand-icases.txt asm tests/hand-icases.s
exact tests/golden-hand-icases.txt hand tests/hand-icases.s tests/emu-golden-icases.txt
# every mnemonic: text to words, words to text, and that text to the same words
exact tests/golden-asm-all.txt asm tests/all.s
exact tests/golden-dis-all.txt dis tests/golden-asm-all.txt
exact tests/golden-asm-all.txt asm tests/golden-dis-all.txt
# refusals: a file with errors, a missing file, text that is not hex words, and two comparisons that must differ
exact tests/golden-asm-errors.txt asm tests/errors.s
exact tests/golden-bytes-errors.txt bytes tests/errors.s
exact tests/golden-asm-missing.txt asm tests/no-such.s
exact tests/golden-dis-bad.txt dis tests/timer.s
exact tests/golden-match-differs.txt match tests/trap.s timer
exact tests/golden-hand-differs.txt hand tests/hand-cases.s tests/emu-golden-mcases.txt
# the M and A extensions: the hand cases of `emu-rv64 xcases` as text, compared with the words in its golden file
exact tests/golden-asm-hand-xcases.txt asm tests/hand-xcases.s
exact tests/golden-hand-xcases.txt hand tests/hand-xcases.s tests/emu-golden-xcases.txt
# the program with MUL, DIV, REM and an LR/SC retry loop: the words, the bytes, the image emu-rv64 runs, and the text of the words
exact tests/golden-asm-mulatomic.txt asm tests/mulatomic.s
exact tests/golden-bytes-mulatomic.txt bytes tests/mulatomic.s
exact tests/golden-same-mulatomic.txt same tests/mulatomic.s tests/emu-mulatomic.img
exact tests/golden-dis-mulatomic.txt dis tests/golden-asm-mulatomic.txt
exact tests/golden-asm-mulatomic.txt asm tests/golden-dis-mulatomic.txt
# the system profile of emu-rv64 0.6.0: a program that sets up Sv39 page tables, delegates, and runs supervisor and user code; the words, the bytes, the image emu-rv64 runs, and the text of the words
exact tests/golden-asm-sv39.txt asm tests/sv39.s
exact tests/golden-bytes-sv39.txt bytes tests/sv39.s
exact tests/golden-same-sv39.txt same tests/sv39.s tests/emu-sv39.img
exact tests/golden-dis-sv39.txt dis tests/golden-asm-sv39.txt
exact tests/golden-asm-sv39.txt asm tests/golden-dis-sv39.txt
# large limits, since 0.4.0: hand cases of as_assemble_big against as_assemble at both image limits and both label limits; the last case takes about a minute
exact tests/golden-ycases.txt ycases
# large limits: both planted defects must be refused by the hand cases
exact tests/golden-ycontrols.txt ycontrols
# a program for the serial run of emu-rv64: the words from asmx and from asm, the bytes, the text it sends, and two runs compared
exact tests/golden-asmx-hello.txt asmx tests/hello.s
exact tests/golden-asmx-hello.txt asm tests/hello.s
exact tests/golden-bytesx-hello.txt bytesx tests/hello.s
exact tests/golden-serial-hello.txt serial tests/hello.s 1000
exact tests/golden-serial-check-hello.txt serial-check tests/hello.s 1000
# a program of 65580 bytes that jumps over 65536 bytes: asm refuses it with the reason of 0.3.0, serial runs it (exit code 3)
exact tests/golden-asm-far.txt asm tests/far.s
exact tests/golden-serial-far.txt serial tests/far.s 100
exact tests/golden-serial-check-far.txt serial-check tests/far.s 100
# a missing file is refused by a large command as by asm
exact tests/golden-asmx-missing.txt asmx tests/no-such.s
